nom: La Roche-Posay Anthelios Clear Skin Dry Touch Face Sunscreen SPF 60

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers are split: several call this their best sunscreen for a matte, non-greasy, velvet finish with reduced shine and pore appearance, while others with oily skin report pilling, peeling, or white cast issues.
segments.dry: Dry-touch finish is repeatedly described as too drying, with one reviewer saying it accentuated crow's feet and worsened dryness when sweating.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers find it functions well as a moisturizer-sunscreen hybrid and doesn't cause breakouts, though one found it very drying.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are divided: some report stinging, burning eyes and white cast, while others say it left skin soft, calm, and did not break them out even while on retinoids.
segments.mature: One reviewer with mature, 50-year-old, oily skin liked the pore-minimizing and matte effect despite some tricky application and white streaking.

concerns.aging: One mature-skin reviewer liked the pore-refining, matte effect; another combination-skin reviewer felt the dry-touch formula accentuated her crow's feet.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers describe the formula as overly drying, causing tightness, peeling, or accentuated fine lines, though some counter this by moisturizing first.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers report stinging or burning around the eyes and skin irritation, though a similar number describe no irritation at all and even a calming effect.
concerns.spots: Not discussed with enough specificity by reviewers.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and praise it as safe under retinoids or other actives; a smaller number mention the product itself causing acne or irritation.
concerns.oiliness: Many oily-skin reviewers report a matte, shine-controlling finish lasting through the day; a few say it still left skin oily or greasy after some hours.

aspects.libelle: White cast on deeper skin tones

extraits.texte: Absolute trash spf, do not buy. Worst spf possible, takes forever to set even after blending 4 times. White cast like crazy and pills, little protection against the sun. Burns eyes really bad and causes acne.

I am medium brown skin African American and unfortunately this product produce a white cast on my face. Also when applied on top of moisturizer the sun screen becomes grainy after a few hours. I love the brand but disappointed in this product.

extraits.titre: Good Sunscreen But Leaves White Cast
extraits.texte: I'm very dark skinned so I'm used to mineral sunscreens leaving a white cast but this is a chemical sunscreen so it should theoretically leave no cast. However no matter how much I rub it in, it leaves a cast and white streaks on my face and baby hairs.

I have combo skin. This sunscreen does the job with sun protection I would say, but I don't like how incredibly drying it was for me. It accentuated my crow's feet. Like the title says, they're not kidding about how it's dry touch!!! I found this sunscreen to be incredibly drying for my skin and the worsttt when you sweat. I have not worn this while swimming yet. When sweating, the sunscreen just slides around and gets on your hands/arms when you wipe the sweat off your face which is annoying. I wonder if this is any better for people with oily skin... I did not experience pilling since I followed the advice of some of the other reviewers by putting on moisturizer and THEN this sunscreen after.

extraits.titre: I like it, it's almost perfect
extraits.texte: I really like it. When I use this my pores look smaller and they pretty much disappear. My face stays matte all day. I have oily, aging, 50 yr old skin. It is a little tricky to apply. I use small amounts in each section and blend it well or you can end up with white streaks. It leaves me a little whiter but I dust a little face powder over it. I am pale to medium olive tone depending on the time a year. It smells like a chemical sunscreen but the smell disappears quickly. I use it anytime I don't want a greasy sunscreen face.

Skin type- super sensitive, acne prone I've tried quite a few sunscreens- hero's mineral sunscreen, eucerin, black girl sunscreen, australian gold, good molecules, and lots more. Those are great, but all occasionally broke me out. I'm on trentinion, and with this sunscreen, I feel protected and I don't feel like it's counterproductive to the retinoid's work on my skin. I've used it for a month now and it's yet to break me out. It leaves the sheerest cast, but hardly noticeable, especially if you wear a touch of any other product really. Will definitely repurchase. A skin safe win!

I have extremely oily skin & tried dffrent suncreens, but this one has been the best for my skim, its not thick so if you wear make up it helps. It has a matte finish that helps reduce shine lightweight and comfortable for daily wear
